left.raw_text: Diagnosed epileptic patients of either sex
coming to the medicine Out Patient /In Patient Departments
and undergoing AED therapy for more than 6 months
Epileptics with high homocysteine levels i.e. > 10.9 µmol/L

right.raw_text: (Normal homocysteine levels are 4.3-9.9 µmol/L for male and 3.3-7.2 µmol/L for female adolescent and a high homocysteine concentration is deaned as at least 11.4 µmol/L for male and at least 10.4 µmol/L for female. Gender mean of high homocysteine concentration is 10.9 µmol/L)
